Quick recipe for overnight oats: mix 1/2 cup oats, 1/2 cup milk, 1 tbsp chia seeds, 1 tsp honey in a jar. Refrigerate overnight. Top with banana and peanut butter in the morning.

Why does the sky turn orange at sunset? Sunlight travels through more atmosphere at low angles, scattering away blue wavelengths via Rayleigh scattering and leaving the longer red and orange wavelengths to reach your eyes.
